DentalHQ is the leading healthcare SaaS membership subscription management platform, helping dental practices grow recurring revenue and deliver better patient experiences. # DentalHQ (DentalHQ, LLC)

DentalHQ is a Software Development company. DentalHQ is a dental membership plan platform that offers customizable dental membership plans for insured and uninsured patients, increase patient loyalty, and ensure predictable revenue. DentalHQ employs 10 people, founded in 2017. Headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Zimbabwe. Has $2.6M in total funding, with 1 prior funding round.

## About

Introducing DentalHQ: the revolutionary in-house membership platform for dentists. Our platform empowers dentists to attract and retain fee-for-service patients while eliminating the hassles of dental insurance. With DentalHQ, you can provide uninsured patients with budgetary control over their dental care, reducing the #1 barrier to attracting uninsured patients: cost. 

Our platform, designed by a dentist, promotes overall patient health by removing barriers to oral healthcare and fosters a direct relationship between you and your patients. Our Saas application allows you to create custom dental membership plans, automate billing and reporting, and includes services to attract and retain new members. 

In addition to plan management, our platform offers patient financing tools, integrated marketing services, expert consultation, patient outreach, and new patient acquisition services, all designed to help you see more fee-for-service patients and increase practice revenue substantially. With a customer retention rate of 94.7%, our proven solutions have helped thousands of practitioners, DSOs, and dental professionals. Choose DentalHQ for the best value in in-house membership plan management.

- Adaptable and curious, able to keep pace with an evolving product and market landscape
- Sharp attention to detail, particularly when configuring accounts, documenting interactions, or delivering training
- Experience as a customer success/retention account manager in dental software is highly desirable
- Experience working in a dental practice office or experience using and/or supporting accounting/billing applications is a plus
- Familiarity with dental practice management software, EHR/EMR systems, or healthcare technology is a strong plus

Company Overview

- Curve Dental is a cloud-based dental software solution provides a modern method to simplifying and streamlining dental practice. It was founded in 2004, and is headquartered in Provo, Utah, USA, with a workforce of 201-500 employees. Its website is http://www.curvedental.com.
